name: AWS Cloud Security, DevOps & SRE
usage: Reference examples only; original client brief and subject-matter approval not supplied.

modules.module_group: Module 1 — Enterprise IAM, Governance & Cryptographic Security
subtopics: Zero-Trust Identity Architecture: principle of least privilege, IAM permission boundaries, condition keys (enforcing source IP, MFA, SSL via aws:SecureTransport), cross-account sts:AssumeRole
Multi-Account Security: AWS Control Tower, SCPs for hard preventative boundaries (e.g., blocking region usage, disallowing public S3)
learning_objectives: Apply least-privilege IAM with permission boundaries and condition keys (source IP, MFA, SSL); configure cross-account sts:AssumeRole
Enforce multi-account guardrails using Control Tower and SCPs

modules.module_group: Module 1 — Enterprise IAM, Governance & Cryptographic Security
subtopics: Key Management & Secrets: AWS KMS architecture (symmetric vs. asymmetric, Customer Managed Keys vs. AWS Managed, key rotation, KMS key policies)
Credential Security: Secrets Manager (automated rotation via Lambda) vs. SSM Parameter Store (hierarchical parameters, KMS encryption)
learning_objectives: Explain KMS architecture and configure key rotation and KMS key policies
Secure credentials with Secrets Manager (Lambda rotation) and SSM Parameter Store

modules.module_group: Module 2 — Network Perimeter, Zero Egress & Traffic Inspection
subtopics: Micro-Segmentation: multi-tier VPC subnet segregation (Public, App-private, Database-isolated) with strict Security Group chaining (referencing security groups instead of IP CIDRs)
Stateless vs. Stateful Inspection: NACLs as subnet-level stateless packet filters vs. Security Groups as stateful firewalls
learning_objectives: Design multi-tier VPC segmentation with Security Group chaining
Differentiate stateless NACLs from stateful Security Groups

modules.topic: Egress Control & PrivateLink  +  Network Threat Visibility
modules.module_group: Module 2 — Network Perimeter, Zero Egress & Traffic Inspection
subtopics: Egress Control & PrivateLink: removing public internet routes for backend infrastructure using VPC Endpoints (Interface Endpoints via PrivateLink and S3/DynamoDB Gateway Endpoints)
Network Threat Visibility: enabling and analyzing VPC Flow Logs with CloudWatch Logs Insights and Athena to detect port scans and anomalous outbound traffic
learning_objectives: Remove public egress using PrivateLink Interface Endpoints and S3/DynamoDB Gateway Endpoints
Analyze VPC Flow Logs with Logs Insights and Athena to detect port scans and anomalous outbound traffic

modules.topic: WAFv2 Core Architecture  +  AWS Managed Rule Sets  +  Custom Rule Development
modules.module_group: Module 3 — Deep Dive: AWS WAF, DDoS & Edge Security
subtopics: WAFv2 Core Architecture: Web ACL structure, association with CloudFront, Application Load Balancers (ALBs), and API Gateways
AWS Managed Rule Sets (AMRs): implementing and tuning the Core Rule Set (CRS / OWASP Top 10), Known Bad Inputs, and SQLi Rule Sets
Custom Rule Development: string matching, regex patterns, Geo-blocking rules, and header-based inspections (enforcing custom secret tokens between CloudFront and ALB)
learning_objectives: Structure WAFv2 Web ACLs and associate with CloudFront, ALBs and API Gateways
Implement and tune AWS Managed Rule Sets (CRS/OWASP, Known Bad Inputs, SQLi)
Develop custom rules — string, regex, geo-blocking, header-based inspection

modules.topic: Rate-Based Rules  +  Bot Control  +  Rule Tuning  +  DDoS & Central Governance
modules.module_group: Module 3 — Deep Dive: AWS WAF, DDoS & Edge Security
subtopics: Rate-Based Rules & Abuse Mitigation: dynamic rate limiting per IP to mitigate brute-force attacks and Layer 7 HTTP flood DDoS
Bot Control & Fraud Protection: Bot Control managed rules, Challenge/CAPTCHA actions, Account Takeover Prevention (ATP) basics
Rule Tuning & Zero False-Positive Testing: Count mode, sampled request inspection, and CloudWatch metrics before promoting rules to Block
DDoS Protection & Central Governance: AWS Shield Standard vs. Shield Advanced, with AWS Firewall Manager to enforce WAF policies across multiple AWS accounts
learning_objectives: Configure rate-based rules against brute-force and L7 HTTP flood DDoS
Apply Bot Control, Challenge/CAPTCHA and ATP basics
Tune rules with Count mode, sampled requests and CloudWatch metrics before Block
Compare Shield Standard vs. Advanced and govern WAF policy across accounts with Firewall Manager

modules.module_group: Module 4 — Compute, Data Security & Threat Detection
subtopics: Storage & Data Perimeter: S3 Bucket Policies (explicit denies for non-TLS, unencrypted uploads), S3 Block Public Access, Object Lock (WORM compliance), EBS default volume encryption
Database Defense-in-Depth: RDS encryption at rest, IAM database authentication, TLS enforcement, Secrets Manager integration
learning_objectives: Harden the S3/EBS data perimeter with bucket policies, Block Public Access, Object Lock and default encryption
Apply RDS defense-in-depth: encryption at rest, IAM database authentication, TLS, Secrets Manager

modules.module_group: Module 4 — Compute, Data Security & Threat Detection
subtopics: Continuous Threat Detection: Amazon GuardDuty (anomaly detection using VPC Flow Logs, DNS logs, and CloudTrail event analysis)
Vulnerability Assessment: Amazon Inspector for automated CVE scans on EC2 instances and ECR container images
learning_objectives: Operate GuardDuty continuous threat detection across Flow Logs, DNS logs and CloudTrail
Run automated CVE assessment with Amazon Inspector on EC2 and ECR images

modules.module_group: Module 5 — Security Automation, IaC & Incident Simulation Capstone
subtopics: Compliance & Posture Management: AWS Config rules for automated drift detection (e.g., flagging unencrypted volumes, open SSH ports) and AWS Security Hub for CSPM benchmarking against CIS AWS Foundations
Automated Remediation: EventBridge-triggered Lambda functions to auto-revoke compromised IAM credentials or isolate infected EC2 instances
learning_objectives: Manage posture with AWS Config drift detection and Security Hub CSPM against CIS AWS Foundations
Build EventBridge-triggered Lambda automated remediation (revoke IAM credentials, isolate EC2)

modules.module_group: Module 5 — Security Automation, IaC & Incident Simulation Capstone
subtopics: Deploy an enterprise 3-tier architecture with CloudFormation or Terraform
Attach AWS WAF to the ALB with rate limiting, geo-blocking, and OWASP protections

Live Attack Lab: simulate an SQL injection attempt, an XSS payload, and an HTTP flood attack using tools like curl or ab to observe WAF metrics, blocked request traces, and CloudWatch alarms in real time
learning_objectives: Deploy a 3-tier architecture via CloudFormation/Terraform and defend it with WAF (rate limiting, geo-blocking, OWASP)
Execute a live attack lab (SQLi, XSS, HTTP flood via curl/ab) and observe WAF metrics, blocked-request traces and CloudWatch alarms
